name: Link or unlink companies for a contact
description: Call this when you need to add new company links to a contact or remove existing company links. Use the separate action "contacts.update_contact" if you only need to modify the contact's own fields.
preconditions: The specified company IDs must refer to existing companies.

contactId.description: The unique identifier of the contact to modify.

unlinkedCompanyIds.description: Array of company IDs to remove from the contact. Can be empty.

newLinkedCompanyIds.description: Array of company IDs to add to the contact. Can be empty.

side_effects: The contact's linked companies are updated according to the provided arrays.
